Subject: Vendor onboarding request — invoice-only path for Gridline pilot

Hi Lukas,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We're excited to kick off the 60-day pilot with Redwood. To keep setup simple on our side, can we request an "invoice-only" onboarding path for the first 90 days rather than full PO integration?

What we can provide now: vendor onboarding form (attached), a short SOC2 summary, and a signed MSA if that helps speed things up. We expect invoice volume under $6k/month during the pilot.

Billing contact: accounts@gridline.ai (CC'd). Preferred payment terms: net30.

We understand Redwood may have policies here — open to whatever controls you need (e.g., spend caps, evidence checklist).

Attachments: Gridline_Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf (application/pdf); Gridline_SOC2_Summary.pdf (application/pdf)

Thanks —
Sasha Reed

Hi Sasha — thanks, got the attachments and the context. Looping in Procurement (Laura) and Finance (Vivek) to confirm what controls we need for an invoice-only pilot.

Proposed quick approach so we can move fast:
- Short-term: invoice-only onboarding for the pilot window with a spend threshold (TBD by Procurement).
- Requirements: completed onboarding form + SOC2 summary + signed MSA.
- Controls: set an internal alert at 75% of monthly threshold + require invoices to route to finance@redwood.com with our internal cost center code.

Laura/Vivek — can you confirm whether Redwood can approve an invoice-only path for a new supplier at ~$6k/month and what documentation you need to close this out?

Lukas — looping in Procurement guidance. Short answer: we can permit an invoice-only onboarding for small pilots but with conditions. Proposed conditional approval below.

Procurement conditional approval (recommended):
1) Thresholds: invoice-only allowed if monthly spend <= $5,000 AND total spend over first 90 days <= $15,000.
2) Required docs: completed vendor onboarding form, SOC2 summary (or equivalent security attestation), and a signed MSA or equivalent terms.
3) Controls: set a hard internal alert when cumulative spend reaches 80% of the 90-day cap; require explicit Procurement re-approval if threshold breached.
4) Finance routing: invoices must be sent to finance@redwood.com and include PO field set to "N/A — invoice-only pilot" and the Redwood cost center provided by Lukas.

If Gridline accepts these conditions (and provides the signed MSA), Procurement will add them to the temporary allowlist and mark vendor profile with the pilot exception. Please capture the vendor tax ID and remit details before the first invoice.

Happy to approve this for the pilot once we have the docs and remit info.

—Laura
Laura Bennett

Redwood Inference
